en.description:
## HP EliteBook 840 G11

A 14-inch business notebook built for daily travel: aluminium chassis, 1.36 kg, spill-resistant backlit keyboard and a 5 MP camera with privacy shutter.

- Intel Core Ultra 7 155U
- 16 GB or 32 GB LPDDR5 memory
- 512 GB or 1 TB NVMe SSD
- Thunderbolt 4, HDMI 2.1, Wi-Fi 6E

Includes a three-year official HP warranty.
